title: Methane detected in the Martian atmosphere

tellings.quote: a distinct possibility in 2003 methane was detected in the Martian atmosphere

plain: In 2003, methane was detected in the atmosphere of Mars, Michels says, and he treats that as making past or present life there "a distinct possibility." He brings it up himself, without naming a source, in an episode with Joe McMoneagle, a former soldier who says he described ancient Mars by remote viewing, a claimed psychic way of seeing distant places.
